title: 第4章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 跟她算账司绵回到家已经大汗淋漓，头发凌乱了，苏建豪拿着报纸从楼上下来，看见她这样，皱眉的开口，“绵绵，你去那里了？怎么弄成这副样子，还不快上去洗澡换件衣服，没洗澡之前别在家里乱跑，免得弄得到处都是灰”“我知道了”司绵敛下眼眸，小跑的上去。刚走完楼梯，还没转弯，迎面苏颂就走过来，嗤笑的扫视了她这身打扮，“小绵羊，你这是去捡垃圾来啊，怎么没人把你当垃圾捡走呢”苏颂就是后爸的儿子，从来不会叫她的名字，只会不停的叫她小绵羊小绵羊，就是觉得她好欺负。司绵没说话，绕过他回到房间，洗完澡出来，就听到苏颂在楼下喊道，“小绵羊，去洗点水果出来，把皮给削了，切成每块大小一样的”把水果洗了切到放到他的面前，苏颂正在玩游戏，头也不抬，没理她。司绵自然是准备快速闪人，才不想跟他多待一秒钟。但是才走两步，苏颂就开口喊住了她，“小绵羊，你工作得怎么样啊？有没有老男人骚扰你啊？”司绵笑笑，“没有，我们公司风气很正，哥，要是没事，我就先上楼了”“连老男人都不想骚扰你，你真是没用”苏颂哼了一声。司绵表面赔笑，心里暗暗发誓，有朝一日，一定要把苏颂的头按进马桶里去，让他吃屎去。…..翌日一早，司绵就赶往公司，天恒可是大公司，在南华市那也是排得上前十的，其实要司绵大专的学历，根本连门槛都踏不进去，更何况现在她连大学毕业证都没拿到，要实习完一年，修完学分，才能回学校拿证书，不过司绵能有幸进来，那也是靠了她后爸的关系的。虽然进去了，但她也只是一个跑腿打杂的。有后门走，司绵也不拒绝，骨气在这个向钱看的年代不值钱。其实后爸为什么那么费心费力让她进天恒，司绵不是不知道理由，学历已经是不可挽回了，工作怎么着也要弄个体面的，以后拿她联姻对方才不会嫌弃。还有一个理由就是，苏建豪爱面子，怕别人说他对待不是亲生的女儿不好。司绵刚走到公司门口，就看见夏日有些狼狈的来上班，看见司绵，夏日跑过去说，“绵绵啊，今天一出门我就遇见贱人了，还跟她上了同一辆车，妈的，在车上，趁人多的时候，她下狠手的踩我脚”司绵看见夏日的脚背上全部都是脚印子，还红肿破皮，气愤不已，“是不是向思怡，她想把你脚废了啊“是啊，以前她就处处针对我，现在仗着她叔叔是天恒一部门的主管，她就更是嚣张，真是欺人太甚了”司绵咬牙切齿，欺负她的人，就是不给她面子。“等着，中午的时候我们好好的跟她算算账，我帮你把仇报回来，保证让她毫无还手之力，还能让你消气，哼，欺负到我头上来了，真以为我是小绵羊啊”夏日重重的点头，有司绵在，她们是绝对不会吃亏的，司绵以前在学校的时候，那是出了名的难搞。脑袋瓜子里，那是小聪明、小计谋不断，整得高年级的学长哭爹叫娘的。长得一张文文弱弱的脸，但是其实可不是一只小白兔。中午，员工食堂，夏日带着司绵去找向思怡的时候，向思怡正在跟她的朋友吃饭，看见夏日带人来，她轻蔑的笑了一下，“夏日，你带这位小妹妹来找我是什么意思呢？是单挑啊还是群挑呢？我们随你选”向思怡明明长得很是青春靓丽，但是口气太嚣张了，完全破坏了整体的美感，司绵忍不住在心里叹息，暴殄天物啊。
content_en: After settling accounts with her, Si Mian was already sweating profusely and his hair was messy. Su Jianhao came downstairs with the newspaper. Seeing her like this, he frowned and said, "Mianmian, where have you been? Why are you like this? Why don't you go up and take a shower and change clothes? Don't run around the house before taking a shower, so as not to get dust everywhere." "I understand." Si Mian lowered his eyes and trotted up. Just after walking up the stairs, before turning the corner, Su Song walked over to her and glanced at her outfit with a sneer, "Little Sheep, you are here to pick up garbage. Why is no one picking you up as garbage?" Su Song is the stepfather's son. He never calls her by her name. He just keeps calling her Little Sheep. He just thinks she is easy to bully. Si Mian didn't say anything, walked around him and returned to the room. When he came out of the shower, he heard Su Song shouting from downstairs, "Little sheep, go wash some fruit and peel it off, and cut it into pieces of the same size." He washed the fruit and cut it and put it in front of him. Su Song was playing a game without raising his head and ignored her. Si Mian was naturally ready to get out of the way quickly and didn't want to stay with him for one more second. But after taking only two steps, Su Song called out to her, "Little Sheep, how are you doing at work? Are there any old men harassing you?" Si Mian smiled, "No, our company has a very upright atmosphere. Brother, if nothing happens, I will go upstairs first." "Even old men don't want to harass you, you are really useless." Su Song snorted. Si Mian smiled apologetically, but secretly swore in his heart that one day, he would push Su Song's head into the toilet and let him eat shit. ….. Early the next morning, Si Mian rushed to the company. Tianheng was a big company, and it was ranked among the top ten in Nanhua City. In fact, Si Mian needed a college degree, which was not even enough to get through. What’s more, she didn’t even get a college diploma. She had to complete a year of internship and complete the credits before she could go back to school to get the certificate. However, Si Mian was lucky enough to get in because of her stepfather’s relationship. Although she went in, she was just an errand boy. Si Mian wouldn't refuse if he had a back door. In this age where money matters, integrity is worthless. In fact, Si Mian didn't know the reason why her stepfather put so much effort into getting her into Tianheng. Her academic qualifications were irretrievable, and she had to get a decent job no matter what, so that the other party wouldn't dislike her if he married her in the future. Another reason is that Su Jianhao loves face and is afraid that others will say that he treats his daughter who is not his biological daughter badly. As soon as Si Mian walked to the door of the company, he saw Xia Xia coming to work in a state of embarrassment. Seeing Si Mian, Xia Xia ran over and said, "Mian Mian, I met a bitch as soon as I went out today, and got into the same car with her. Damn, in the car, when there were many people, she stepped on my feet ruthlessly." Si Mian saw that Xia Xia's insteps were all covered with footprints, and they were also red, swollen and broken. , angrily said, "Is it Xiang Siyi, she wants to cripple you?" "Yes, she used to target me everywhere, and now that her uncle is the head of Tianheng's department, she is even more arrogant. She is really bullying others." Si Mian gritted his teeth. The person who bullied her just didn't give her face. "Wait, let's settle the accounts with her at noon, I I will help you get revenge. I will make sure that she has no power to fight back, and it will also make you feel better. Humph, you bullied me. You really thought I was a little sheep." Xia Xia nodded heavily. With Si Mian here, they would never suffer. When Si Mian was in school, he was notoriously difficult to deal with. In his head, there were constant cleverness and little schemes. The senior student was crying. He had a gentle and weak face, but he was actually not a little white rabbit. At noon, when Xia Tian took Si Mian to find Xiang Siyi, Xiang Siyi was eating with her friends. When she saw Xia Tian bringing someone here, she smiled contemptuously, "Xia Tian, what do you mean by bringing this little sister to me? Is it a one-on-one challenge or a group challenge? We'll let you choose." Xiang Siyi looked very young and beautiful, but her tone was too arrogant, which completely destroyed the overall beauty. Si Mian couldn't help but sigh in his heart, what a waste of natural resources.
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
